status: **Status**: v3.2.0 has two sub-plans. (1) `adoption-teach` -- all 3 of 3 phases complete on `feat/adoption-teach`, merged into `develop` (merge `8523281`): core `session-teach-back` skill + modes/depth-levels/checklist + cross-links. (2) `adoption-headroom` -- all 7 of 7 phases complete on `feat/adoption-headroom` (branched off the post-teach `develop` merge `8523281`). **Phase 1** (Foundation + SmartCrusher): scaffolded `extensions/nexus-context-compressor` (no-op `compress` pipeline + `CompressResult` metrics + an offline-safe tiktoken/stdlib token counter), implemented the deterministic SmartCrusher JSON-array dedup (global-uniqueness + adjacent-change scoring, stable SHA-256 CCR markers `<<ccr:HASH N_rows>>`), and registered the package copy + editable-install block in both installers (no MCP registration yet -- deferred to Phase 4). **Phase 2** (CCR reversible store): added the `ccr/` subpackage -- a shared marker codec (`ccr/marker.py`, single source of truth for the `<<ccr:HASH N_rows>>` grammar so producer and consumer cannot drift), a local SQLite `CCRStore` (`ccr/store.py`, content-addressed, idempotent `put`, WAL, oldest-first `prune` eviction) wired into SmartCrusher via optional dependency injection (`smart_crush(records, store=...)` stays pure when `store=None`), and the `retrieve()` interface (`ccr/retrieve.py`) that resolves a marker/object/bare-hash back to the originals or a named `NOT_FOUND` sentinel, never raising. 68 package tests pass (19 Phase 1 + 49 Phase 2; 100% coverage on `ccr/`); the round-trip is provably lossless and survives a store restart; `make validate` emulated green; no shell surface this phase. Deferred SmartCrusher refinements are logged below as DF-v32hr-1..3; the Phase 2 eviction-scheduling deferral is DF-v32hr-4. **Phase 3** (Remaining deterministic strategies): added the three remaining transforms -- `transforms/cache_aligner.py` (KV-cache prefix stabilizer: regex-detects volatile tokens -- dates, times, UUIDs, long-hex hashes, semantic versions, epoch timestamps -- moves those lines to the tail and normalizes whitespace, leaving a byte-identical stable prefix; optional spaCy NER seam default-off and graceful), `transforms/code_compressor.py` (AST-aware function/method body elision that REUSES the `nexus-code-search` tree-sitter extractors via `parse_file` rather than re-vendoring grammars, keeps imports/decorators/signatures/class structure by eliding only innermost body interiors, emits reversible `<<ccr:HASH N_rows>>` markers for bodies >= `ccr_min_lines` and a plain note for smaller ones, with a dependency-free regex/indent/brace fallback for unsupported languages or when the AST infra is absent), and `transforms/content_router.py` (classifies JSON-array / JSON-object / code / log / text and dispatches arrays to SmartCrusher + code to CodeCompressor, splitting mixed content on fenced code blocks and threading the CCR store). Extended the marker codec (`ccr/marker.py`) with `find_marker` / `find_all_markers` for markers embedded in free text (the form CodeCompressor leaves inside code comments) and registered the package in the `make test` target. 130 package tests pass (62 added in Phase 3; 92% total coverage, `ccr/` still 100%, the three new transforms 88-97%); all four sibling extension suites (skill-server 43, code-search 201, web-fetch 29, skill-scanner 87) remain green (no regressions); `make validate` emulated green; `make lint` N/A (Python-only, no shell surface). New Phase 3 deferrals/limitations are logged below as DF-v32hr-5..8. **Phase 4** (Runtime integration + retire rtk): added the runtime seam `compress_output(text, persist=...)` (the single-blob entry the hook and MCP call) plus a CLI (`compress`/`retrieve`/`serve` subcommands), wired the top-level `compress(messages)` through ContentRouter (no longer a no-op; identity on prose, so the Phase 1 scaffold tests stay green), and added a runtime "never expand / never lose output" guard. Shipped the opt-in/default-off PreToolUse hook `catalog/hooks/compress-output.sh` (rewrites a Bash command so its stdout pipes through the engine, preserving the exit code via `PIPESTATUS`; jq-gated, fail-open; registered in `settings.json` and copied by both installers) with a pytest suite, and the internal MCP server (`server.py`, lazy-`mcp` import behind the optional `[mcp]` extra) exposing `context_compress` + `context_retrieve`, registered in `catalog/mcp-configs/mcp-servers.json` (re-full) with a matrix row, auto-registered + `[mcp]`-installed by both installers, and added to CI (the compressor extension suite was not previously CI-gated -- now fixed). Superseded the external rtk recommendation in `guides/RTK_CONTEXT_COMPRESSION.md` (+ the `base-claude.md` template line) with an honest parity note. 159 package tests pass (29 added in Phase 4); the full `catalog/hooks` suite (434, incl. 8 new hook tests), `tests/validators` (136), `tests/installer` (70), `tests/integrations` (197) all green; all `make validate` validators 0 errors; skill-security gate exit 0; ShellCheck clean (new hook + installer.sh); installer.ps1 parses clean; a throwaway-venv `[mcp]`-extra install + `serve` startup confirmed. DF-v32hr-7 is resolved here; new Phase 4 items are DF-v32hr-9..11 and WN-v32hr-1..2; DF-v32hr-4 (auto-prune) refined and kept open. **Phase 5** (Accuracy-regression harness): added the top-level `extensions/nexus-context-compressor/evals/` harness (sibling of `src/`/`tests/`, runnable as `python -m evals` after a self-bootstrap of `src/` onto `sys.path`, so no install is needed) that proves compression preserves answer quality via deterministic, offline structural-fidelity checks instead of a live-LLM benchmark: CCR round-trip completeness (reconstruct == original for JSON arrays; elided code bodies resolve back exactly), signature-preservation rate for code, and a tokenizer-free character-reduction effectiveness floor. Shipped a fixed local dataset (`fixtures/`: two JSON arrays + a Python and a TypeScript module with a `manifest.json` answer key), a committed `baseline.json` (fidelity pinned at 1.0; effectiveness floor 0.36, a 10-point margin below the measured 0.458), Markdown/JSON reports, and an intentional `--update-baseline` path. Wired the gate three ways: a `make compress-eval` target, a step inside `make validate`, and a step in the CI `validate` job alongside the skill-security gate. 12 new harness tests (incl. the load-bearing proof that an irreversible compressor -- a no-op CCR store -- is caught by the gate, plus synthetic below-floor / signature-loss detections); 171 package tests pass total; the gate command runs verbatim green (CCR 100%, signatures 100%, reduction 45.8%); AST and regex strategies produce identical fixture numbers so the floor is environment-independent. New Phase 5 items are DF-v32hr-12..13 and WN-v32hr-3. **Phase 6** (Optional ML token-dropper): added `transforms/ml_token_dropper.py` -- a DEFAULT-OFF, lossy, opt-in free-text compressor that ports headroom's Kompress ModernBERT importance-scoring drop. It scores each whitespace word (a pluggable `scorer` seam; the shipped default backend loads pre-placed public ONNX weights via the optional `[ml]` extra, now `onnxruntime`+`numpy`+`tokenizers`), keeps the top `target_ratio` by importance, and rebuilds readable text preserving inter-word spacing of surviving runs. It is offline-first to the strongest degree -- the module never downloads weights (it only *loads* pre-placed local ones, like tiktoken's vocab / the v3.0.0 OSV.dev DB) and sends no user data anywhere -- and degrades gracefully (onnxruntime/numpy/tokenizers or weights absent, or a failing scorer => original text + a precise install hint, never a raise or a fetch). It is a standalone transform (exported from `transforms/`), NOT wired into the default ContentRouter/`compress` pipeline, so the deterministic strategies remain the default. 35 new tests (206 package tests pass, 2 numpy-reduction tests skip via `importorskip` since the heavy deps are absent), covering off-by-default, drop-to-ratio with an injected scorer, every backend degradation branch via `sys.modules` stubs, no-network (socket poisoned), determinism, and the pure selection/reconstruction/pooling helpers; the Phase 5 accuracy gate re-runs green with the module present (it is off the deterministic pipeline by design). **Phase 6 reconciliation (2026-06-10)**: Phase 6 was implemented twice in parallel (a duplicate run on a second machine); the pushed implementation (`e6ddbc5`) was kept as the base and **CCR-reversibility was grafted onto it** per the maintainer's decision, so the dropper now upholds the engine's every-drop-reversible invariant: `drop_tokens(text, *, store=...)` persists the full original behind a `<<ccr:HASH N_rows>>` marker appended to the kept preview (resolvable via `retrieve`, exactly like SmartCrusher/CodeCompressor), with a never-expand guard so the marker's token cost never grows a small payload; with `store=None` (the default) it stays the pure lossy preview e6ddbc5 shipped, so all 35 original tests are unchanged. 7 reversibility tests added (full suite green: 215 pass on this host where numpy is present; the 2 numpy-reduction tests skip on a numpy-absent host). New Phase 6 items: DF-v32hr-10 resolved (the scheduled free-text mechanism shipped, opt-in/default-off); new DF-v32hr-14 (ML dropper not wired into the default runtime pipeline), DF-v32hr-15 (whitespace-word vs upstream sub-word granularity), MT-v32hr-1 (the live ONNX inference glue is unrunnable in CI without the `[ml]` deps + weights), WN-v32hr-4 (partial Windows local verification). **Phase 7** (Methodology cross-links + docs): cross-linked `nexus-context-compressor` as the programmatic counterpart in the three context skills (`catalog/skills/orchestration/context-compression`, `orchestration/prompt-token-optimization`, `developer-experience/context-optimization`) with a "when to reach for the engine" note + `[[ ]]` cross-links and no engine-internals duplication; replaced `context-optimization`'s verbatim `cargo install --git rtk` setup with the internal-engine setup (`NEXUS_CONTEXT_COMPRESS=1`) + an rtk-migration note (resolving DF-v32hr-11); surgically synced that skill's now-false rtk `description`/`overview_l1` in `data/skills.json` (a full `build-catalog` regen of the broader frontmatter-to-`skills.json` drift is left to the release-time bump, same disposition as WN-v32-3); expanded the engine README with an `Architecture` section (ContentRouter -> strategy pipeline, module map, CCR reversibility, local-first/zero-outbound, ML offline-first, rtk migration) and added a project-level `docs/v3/v3.2/context-compressor-architecture.md`. Documentation-only, no code/shell surface: the full validator suite (bundles/personal-paths/unicode/supply-chain/workflow/solution-frontmatter/version-sync) ran 0 errors, the 215-test compressor suite passed, the compression accuracy gate passed (CCR 100%, signatures 100%, reduction 45.8%), and the skill-security scan exited 0 (no HIGH/CRITICAL). No new Phase 7 deferrals; DF-v32hr-11 moves to Resolved. adoption-headroom is now complete end-to-end. The v3.2.0 version bump, CHANGELOG finalization, count-prose reconciliation, and tag are applied at the develop->main release (owned by `/update version` / `/update release`).
